title.value: Evaluation of a prenatal screening decision aid: A mixed methods pilot study

title.quote: Evaluation of a prenatal screening decision aid: A mixed methods pilot study

extractions.description: This paper evaluates the usefulness and acceptability of a decision aid (DA) designed to help pregnant women and their partners make informed decisions about prenatal screening for trisomy.
